item.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more (November 2, 2026)
item.description: The agentic launches that stayed with me last week had nothing to do with how capable a model is AWS Step Functions, which already orchestrates over 220 AWS services, can now be handed to an agent as a tool, so workflows teams already trust became callable without a rewrite

item.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
item.description: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.

item.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
item.description: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT The post Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
